summary: The Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard University is accepting applications for its 2027-28 fellowships in Cambridge, United States. The fellowship is for working journalists with at least five years of full-time media experience. International applications are due 1 December 2026, while the U.S. deadline is 31 January 2027. Fellowships start around mid-August.
highlights: At least five years of full-time media experience; student journalism does not count and PR professionals are excluded.
Application: two essays, professional profile, study proposal summary, work samples and three recommendation letters.
International applicants apply by 1 December 2026; their recommendation letters are due 15 December.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Nieman Foundation page before applying.
